summary.tldr: Amends federal parks laws to expand protected areas, create new park sites, rename one park reserve, and update rules on discharges and fishing.
what_it_does: Broadens and clarifies offences for discharging or depositing substances in national parks, national park reserves, and Rouge National Urban Park.
Expands the boundaries of seven national parks and one national park reserve.
Creates the Akami-Uapishk? KakKasuak Mealy Mountains National Park Reserve of Canada and sets out rules for its operation and administration.
Renames Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve of Canada to Gwaii Haanas National Park Reserve and Haida Heritage Site.
Establishes the Tallurutiup Imanga National Marine Conservation Area.
Makes related changes to the National Parks of Canada Fishing Regulations.
who_it_affects: Visitors to Rouge National Urban Park
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada National Parks Act, the Canada National Marine Conservation Areas Act, the Rouge National Urban Park Act, and the National Parks of Canada Fishing Regulations.
